subject: Pipeline clarity: mid-week ownership & commit sync
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline clarity: mid-week ownership & commit sync

Team —

Quick mid-week note to tighten coverage numbers before tomorrow's finance check: we need accurate stage assignments for any deal > $50k ARR and confirmation on which opportunities are confident commit for this quarter. Finance asked for a reconciled coverage number by end of day tomorrow.

What I need from each of you today:
- Update stages in HubSpot for every open opportunity you own (focus: Qualified, Proposal, Commit).
- Mark the top 6 deals with a single-line reason if you moved them (e.g., PO pending, legal review, budget hold).
- For any partial commits (split ARR), add an inline comment with the counted amount.

I've attached a snapshot (Coverage_Snapshot_20260928.xlsx) with my current rollup. Numbers will change quickly; please make HubSpot updates first so finance pulls the live report. If you're waiting on procurement/PO, add the external contact + expected date in the note.

I'll run a 30-minute quick sync at 3:30pm PT if we need it; otherwise I'll send a short rollup at 4pm.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Coverage_Snapshot_20260928.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline clarity: mid-week ownership & commit sync

Thanks Jordan — I'm on it. Quick updates:
- ACME (Owner: Marissa) — moved from Proposal -> Commit. Waiting on signed SOW from Alex Ward (alex.ward@acmecorp.com); they said EOD Thursday. Counting full ARR in the rollup but added a note with the expected sign date.
- Nimbus Health — moved from Qualified -> Proposal; asking for pricing alignment call today. Not counting as commit.
- Meridian Data — updated stage to Proposal and set next step: technical review (expected 10/5).

I'll update HubSpot now and add short comments in the coverage snapshot tab. If anyone wants me to ping Alex at ACME, I can do that — I have a direct line.

Thanks all — solid progress. Summary / next steps: 
- I pulled the live report at 3:55pm PT: coverage moved from 1.8x -> 2.05x against target after the updates (includes Summit PO, ACME SOW counted pending signature per Marissa's note, and Orion counted at 60%).
- Owners/confirmations:
  - Summit Analytics (Ben) — counted as commit, attach saved. Legal risk noted; CS will confirm implementation window.
  - ACME (Marissa) — counted as commit based on explicit EOD sign from Alex; Marissa to confirm once SOW is in hand.
  - Orion (Lauren) — partial commit counted per note; we will reconcile in the closebook if we receive full ARR earlier.

I'll send the reconciled number to finance and ops now and flag any changes before EOD tomorrow. If anything materializes (signed SOW/updated PO), reply-all with the doc and I'll adjust the rollup.

If anyone wants the 3:30pm quick sync we can still run it tomorrow morning — otherwise I think we have enough to close the book for today's rollup.

Thanks — great work getting these updated quickly.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
